text.zh-CN:
干眼是泪液不足、蒸发过快或不能有效保护眼表，造成反复不适。

- 可有烧灼、沙粒感、发红和阵发模糊；流泪多也不能排除干眼。
- 通常能通过护理和滴眼治疗改善，但疼痛或视力下降不能只归于干眼。
text.en:
Dry eye occurs when tears are insufficient, evaporate too fast or fail to protect the eye surface.

- Burning, grittiness, redness and fluctuating blur can occur; watery eyes do not exclude dryness.
- Care and eye drops often help, but pain or vision loss needs separate assessment.

text.zh-CN:
泪液数量、质量和眼睑功能都会影响干涩。

- 长时间看屏幕、风吹、烟雾及空调可使症状加重。
- 年龄增加、隐形眼镜、某些药物及干燥综合征等自身免疫病增加风险。
text.en:
Tear amount, quality and eyelid function all matter.

- Prolonged screens, wind, smoke and air conditioning can worsen symptoms.
- Older age, contacts, some medicines and autoimmune conditions such as Sjögren syndrome increase risk.

text.zh-CN:
突然视力变化或红眼伴明显疼痛时，应及时评估。

- 突然视力下降、闪光或视野异常，立即眼科急诊。
- 红眼伴剧痛、明显怕光或严重头痛恶心需紧急评估；戴隐形眼镜出现红痛应停戴并尽快求医。
text.en:
Sudden visual changes or painful red eyes need prompt assessment.

- Sudden vision loss, flashes or visual-field changes need emergency eye care.
- Redness with severe pain, marked light sensitivity or headache and nausea needs urgent assessment; stop contacts and seek prompt care for painful redness.

text.zh-CN:
按照严重程度和持续时间就诊。

- 轻度干涩可先咨询药师，改善环境并试用合适润滑产品。
- 数周仍未改善、妨碍阅读工作或眼睑形态变化，应预约眼科；疼痛和视力改变需更早评估。
text.en:
Arrange care according to severity and duration.

- For mild symptoms, ask a pharmacist about suitable lubricants and environmental changes.
- Symptoms lasting weeks, interfering with reading or work, or altered eyelid shape need an eye appointment; pain or visual change requires earlier care.

text.zh-CN:
检查既评估泪液，也寻找其他眼病。

- 说明屏幕时间、隐形眼镜、用药及是否伴口干等其他症状。
- 医生可测泪液量、蒸发速度并检查眼睑；单次泪液测量不能说明全部问题。
text.en:
Assessment evaluates tears and other eye conditions.

- Describe screen time, contacts, medicines and other symptoms such as dry mouth.
- Tests may measure tear quantity and evaporation and examine eyelids; one measurement cannot explain every symptom.

text.zh-CN:
干涩、红、痒和模糊并非干眼独有。

- 睫毛根部的眼睑边缘发炎（睑缘炎）可与干眼并存，过敏也可能导致瘙痒流泪。
- 持续红痛需排除感染；急性视力变化不能靠试滴润眼液来诊断。
text.en:
Dryness, redness, itching and blur are not unique to dry eye.

- Eyelid inflammation may coexist, while allergy can cause itching and tearing.
- Persistent painful redness needs infection assessment; trying lubricants cannot diagnose acute visual change.

text.zh-CN:
目标是改善舒适度并保护角膜。

- 人工泪液补充润滑，环境调整减少泪液蒸发，睑缘护理改善油脂分泌。
- 较重者可需要处方滴眼液、泪点栓塞或眼睑手术，由检查结果决定。
text.en:
Treatment improves comfort and protects the cornea.

- Artificial tears lubricate, environmental changes reduce evaporation and eyelid care supports oil secretion.
- More severe cases may need prescription drops, tear-duct plugs or eyelid surgery based on examination.

text.zh-CN:
润滑产品和处方药用途不同。

- 人工泪液、凝胶或眼膏按说明使用；瓶口避免触碰眼睛，不共用滴眼液。
- 较重者可用处方抗炎滴眼液，不能自行加用激素滴眼液；怀疑全身药物致干眼先咨询，勿自行停药。
- 处方选择包括环孢素等调节眼表炎症的滴眼液，具体品种按当地可用药物决定。激素滴眼液如地塞米松需医生监督，因为可能升高眼压或影响晶状体；使用后视力持续模糊或眼痛，应立即联系眼科。
text.en:
Lubricants and prescription drops serve different purposes.

- Use artificial tears, gels or ointments as directed; keep bottle tips off the eye and do not share drops.
- Severe cases may need prescription anti-inflammatory drops; do not self-start steroid drops or stop suspected contributing medicines without advice.
- Prescription options include cyclosporine drops that address inflammation on the eye surface; availability varies locally. Steroid drops such as dexamethasone require supervision because they can raise eye pressure or affect the lens. Persistent blurred vision or eye pain during use needs immediate eye-care advice.

text.zh-CN:
均衡营养和适当饮水有助于眼部健康。

- 正常摄取含维生素A和脂肪酸的食物，无限液要求时保持适当饮水。
- 现有页面不能证明所有干眼患者服鱼油或高剂量维生素都有效，因此不作统一补充建议。
text.en:
Balanced nutrition and suitable hydration support eye health.

- Include normal food sources of vitamin A and fatty acids and suitable fluids if not restricted.
- These pages do not prove universal benefit from fish oil or high-dose vitamins, so no blanket supplementation is advised.

text.zh-CN:
减少蒸发和刺激，保持眼睑清洁。

- 看屏幕时定时休息并完整眨眼，让屏幕略低于眼平面。
- 用温而不烫的湿巾按指导护理眼睑，避开烟尘和直吹空调，不适时改戴眼镜。
text.en:
Reduce evaporation and irritation and keep eyelids clean.

- Take screen breaks, blink fully and position screens slightly below eye level.
- Use a warm, not hot, cloth for advised eyelid care, avoid smoke and direct air conditioning, and switch from contacts to glasses when uncomfortable.

text.zh-CN:
部分人需要评估相关疾病和用药。

- 老人和隐形眼镜使用者较易干眼，护理和配戴习惯需复核。
- 伴明显口干或自身免疫病者，眼部与全身问题应一起管理；长期多药者由医生核对药物影响。
text.en:
Some people need associated disease and medicine review.

- Older adults and contact-lens wearers are at higher risk and should review care habits.
- Dry mouth or autoimmune disease warrants coordinated assessment; people on multiple medicines need prescriber review of possible effects.

text.zh-CN:
症状常随环境和用眼量波动。

- 有效护理通常需要持续，不能仅在特别难受时才做。
- 复诊说明视力、疼痛和生活影响；治疗无效应重查原因，而非无限加滴眼次数。
text.en:
Symptoms often fluctuate with environment and visual demands.

- Helpful care commonly needs to continue beyond severe episodes.
- Report vision, pain and daily-life effects at review; ineffective treatment needs reassessment rather than endlessly increasing drops.

text.zh-CN:
多数是刺激不适，严重者可能损伤眼表。

- 反复模糊与干涩可妨碍阅读、开车或屏幕工作。
- 严重未治疗干眼可损伤角膜，即眼球前方透明层；持续视力下降应尽快检查。
text.en:
Most cases cause irritation, but severe disease can damage the surface.

- Recurrent blur and discomfort can impair reading, driving or screen work.
- Severe untreated dryness may damage the cornea, the clear front layer; persistent vision loss needs prompt examination.

text.zh-CN:
预防重点是减少屏幕、环境和隐形眼镜相关刺激。

- 避免长时间连续盯屏幕，减少烟尘、干燥及直吹风。
- 按规范使用隐形眼镜，并持续治疗睑缘炎或相关疾病，反复红痛则暂停佩戴就医。
text.en:
Prevention focuses on reducing screen, environmental and contact-lens irritation.

- Break up screen use and reduce smoke, dryness and direct wind.
- Use contacts correctly and manage eyelid or associated disease; recurrent painful redness requires stopping lenses and seeking care.

limitations.zh-CN: 面向普通读者的扩充医学信息草稿，已核读所列官方资料的相关章节；逐项独立论证、地区适用性核准及医学签审尚未完成，不构成个体诊断或处方。
limitations.en: Expanded educational draft based on inspected official patient-information sections. Independent claim verification, regional applicability review and clinical sign-off remain pending; this is not an individual diagnosis or prescription.
